label: Playable races on the Skyrim humanoid rig
description: One roster instead of a character file per build. The rig and its animations are built once and shared; each build carries only its own skin. A new race is one entry in config/skyrim-playable-races.json plus two appearances/<race>-<sex>.json.
referenceNotes: A reference build is the one whose meshes the support envelopes and the fitted hurtbox are measured from. There is one per sex because female bodies, hands and feet are different meshes from the male ones, so the lowest visible surface grounding and the hurtbox depend on is not shared across sexes (decision 0054). The rig GLB and its clips are emitted once, by the male reference: the skeleton is shared and the clips are sex-agnostic.
